files.name: motion-prompt-082.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Image zoom on hover" (ホバーで画像ズーム), one of the names in "Landing page & web effects".
Motion Prompt #082

What it is: The photo enlarges inside a fixed frame
What the sample shows: The photo under the cursor slowly enlarges while its frame stays the same size, and shrinks back when the cursor leaves.
Spec:
- Two photo frames, 222 × 118 (radius 8). The cursor rests on the left one, then the right one, for about 1.5 s each.
- On hover the content scales 1→1.15 from the centre over 0.5 s (cubic ease-out); on leave it returns over 0.5 s.
- Anything outside the frame is clipped (overflow: hidden). The frame and the caption do not move.
When to use it: Use it on photo grids (work, products, articles) to show which item is about to be chosen.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/082.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/lp.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
